maddeler.e:
انقلعت (form VII)
# اِنْقَلَعْتُ (inqalaʕtu) /in.qa.laʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْقَلَعَ (inqalaʕa)
# اِنْقَلَعْتَ (inqalaʕta) /in.qa.laʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْقَلَعَ (inqalaʕa)
# اِنْقَلَعْتِ (inqalaʕti) /in.qa.laʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْقَلَعَ (inqalaʕa)
# اِنْقَلَعَتْ (inqalaʕat) /in.qa.la.ʕat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
